s.t: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Marketing & Management leaders imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts — and crafting the narratives that bring those products to the world.

They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking, deep research, and compelling go-to-market storytelling.

They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, marketing, and communications, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

You will be part of the team responsible for product roadmaps and launches at Airbnb. You will drive specific features that are part of every launch and determine how they are positioned and communicated to the external world. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release to growth. And your cross-functional work ensures a consistent product voice across the experiences being built at Airbnb.

We are seeking a Product Marketing & Management leader to join our Tickets team. Tickets is a new and fast-growing business spanning attractions, tours, and live events, and you'll be at the forefront of defining the category for Airbnb — shaping a product guests love, building the supply that powers it, and telling the story that brings it to market. Working as a Product Manager at MG AI
While engineers focus on building and shipping models, Product Managers at MG AI own the why and the what. We translate complex, often ambiguous business challenges from Match Group's brands into clear ML product strategy, and we drive execution across a globally distributed team. The PMs who thrive here are strategic troubleshooters with a bias for action: they spot what is blocking progress and drive it to resolution instead of waiting.
This is a communication-first role, but that does not mean coordination alone. Your core job is to figure out which problem is worth solving, articulate it in clear and precise language, and drive alignment among a diverse set of stakeholders across cultures and time zones. You own the product thinking end to end: framing the problem, shaping the plan, and defining what we build.
You will work on projects that leverage a wide range of technologies, from on-device ML modules to server-side AI models and LLMs. You do not need to be an ML expert on day one, but you must learn fast and become technically fluent enough to make sound product calls, because the technology and the problems keep changing.

Frame the Problem: Figure out which problems are worth solving and why, and articulate them in clear, precise language that a diverse team can rally around.
Shape the Roadmap: Decide what matters most, sequence the work, make the tradeoffs, and write PRDs, keeping partners aligned as priorities shift.
Navigate Complex Stakeholder Maps: Act as the connective tissue between Match Group's brands, and the many functions within them, and MG AI engineering. Read the unspoken dynamics, build alignment across brands, functions, cultures, and time zones, and keep everyone moving in the same direction.
Hands-on Execution: Stay deeply involved in the details. Use experiments, behavioral data, and research to guide your calls when signals are imperfect, unblock engineering, and make the small decisions that keep a project moving.

Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Management (most important): You excel at managing stakeholders in complex, high-ambiguity situations. You read between the lines, sense interpersonal and organizational dynamics, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities. This is the single most important quality for this role.
4-6 years of product management experience in the Tech domain, ideally on complex systems or data or ML-driven products.
Fast Learning Curve & Strong Will to Learn: You do not need to be ML-savvy today, but you must ramp quickly and become technically fluent enough to shape direction on model behavior and tradeoffs without needing to be deeply technical.
Fluent in English (Able to conduct business meetings and participate in complex discussions without requiring assistance.)
Fluent in Korean (Sophisticated professional interactions with native-level precision and an understanding of cultural nuances.) Essential for cross-functional collaboration within the Seoul office.
Strong Ownership & Bias for Action: A track record of driving problems to resolution without waiting for permission. You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and making principled calls when the signals are imperfect.
Analytical Rigor: Comfort with data. You can define metrics, design and read experiments, and let evidence guide your decisions.
Global Operational Readiness: Ability to accommodate flexible working hours for regular early morning syncs with US teams (EST/PST).

A Point of View on AI Tooling: A clear sense of how AI tools can raise the quality and speed of product work, and a habit of using them (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).

Our mission is to democratize high-performance advertising by enabling brands to achieve world-class results with minimal friction. To achieve this, we need an incredibly robust, scalable, and state-of-the-art Machine Learning infrastructure.

The Ads ML Platform team is at the core of this mission, tasked with building the foundation that powers all of our content understanding, ad targeting, and ad ranking models. We are empowering our ML engineers and data scientists to move faster and build smarter.

As the Senior Product Manager for the Ads ML Platform, you will hold significant ownership over the infrastructure and tools that make our ads marketplace intelligent. You will define the vision and build the roadmap for a platform that enables unparalleled engineering velocity and supports the most modern ML architectures.
You will be the bridge between complex ML systems and business outcomes. Whether it's integrating generative AI to increase developer productivity, establishing unified model-serving infrastructure, or optimizing GPU utilization, your work will directly accelerate how quickly and effectively we can ship highly-performant ad products. If you are passionate about the intersection of platform engineering and state-of-the-art ML research, this is the role for you.

Define the Vision: Shape the long-term strategy and roadmap for Reddit’s Ads ML platform, ensuring we are adopting cutting-edge technologies (including Generative AI and LLM workflows) to stay ahead of the curve.
Accelerate Velocity: Build products and tooling that dramatically reduce friction for Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs) and Data Scientists, enabling them to train, deploy, and iterate on models faster than ever.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, and Ads Product teams to understand their constraints, prioritize platform initiatives, and deliver scalable infrastructure.
Drive Execution and Adoption: Own key performance indicators (KPIs) around platform reliability, latency, cost-efficiency, usage metrics, and developer productivity.
Stay Cutting-Edge: Keep your finger on the pulse of the broader ML ecosystem. Read the latest research papers, understand emerging architectures, and determine how they can be practically applied to Reddit’s Ads ML platform.
Distill pain points, translate to requirements : Conduct regular user research with MLEs in Ranking, Creative Effectiveness and Content Understanding to convert pain points (e.g., slow backfills, limited training speed, no way to quickly share features across models) into precise product requirements. Validate the needs and ensure they are tied into a broader vision for the org.

The Opportunity: Product Manager, Cash We're hiring a Product Manager for our cash products, the fast, high-volume liquidity products at the center of the business. You'll own meaningful surfaces of products used by millions, with the room and expectation to run big pieces yourself. This is a builder's seat on a highly analytical team.

You'll live in the data, work comfortably with analysis, design and read experiments, and move fast on a product where small changes compound across huge volume. We want someone self-directed enough to take an ambiguous problem, frame it, and drive it to a shipped result without a lot of hand-holding.

The people who thrive here set their own direction and don't wait to be told what to work on. Analytical horsepower is the baseline. We also want you to bring, and keep building, a real user point of view.

You'll have strong analytical partners around you, and the growth edge in this role is pairing that rigor with sharper instincts for the user experience. How You'll Make an Impact Meaningful surfaces of the cash products, from problem framing through experiment design, launch, and readout.

A steady cadence of experiments: you define the hypotheses, get the instrumentation right, and interpret results with an eye on timing and release mechanics. The trade-offs between business outcomes and user experience on a high-volume product where both matter.

Clear, direct communication of what you're doing and why, to a demanding, fast-moving set of stakeholders. Coordination with Compliance, Legal, Operations, Credit, Design, and Support on product changes, including regulatory reviews, support escalation workflows, and operational readiness.

You know how the surfaces you own perform, where the friction is, and where the biggest experiment opportunities sit. By day 60: Sharp hypotheses on your top opportunities, with the first experiments designed, instrumented, and in build.

By day 90: Experiments live and reading out, with a prioritized backlog and a clear point of view on what to double down on next. Why You're a Great Fit Strong analytical foundation. You're fluent in data, experienced with dashboards and SQL, and you understand A/B testing, experiment timing, and release mechanics in depth. Self-direction.

You take a loosely defined problem and drive it forward on your own initiative. People who need a fully scoped brief to get moving struggle here. A builder's background. You're clear, concise, and direct, and you can make your reasoning legible to a sharp audience. Drive and velocity. You move quickly and take real ownership of outcomes. Growing user instincts. You care about the user experience, not just the metric, and you want to sharpen that muscle. We'll support that growth.

Comfort operating in a regulated environment. You'll work closely with Legal, Compliance, Design, Credit and Support, seeking partnerships as part of the product process to deliver stronger outcomes. Consumer product experience is a plus. Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools.

You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams.

Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

· Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.

· Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.

· Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.

· Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.

· Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.

· Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.

· Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

· A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.

· Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.

· The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.

· Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.

· A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.

· An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.

· A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

· Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.

· The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.

· Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.

· A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.

· Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.

· As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists.

You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers.

The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery. This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset.

You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives , serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution.

You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts.

The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models.

In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization. Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Delivery
Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.
Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding
Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.
Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise
Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:

Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
Partner margin and discount models.
Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
Usage and cost transparency.
Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation
Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.
Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership
Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.
Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance
Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
